references.text: Joshua's command to take twelve stones from the Jordan, which the Israelites now carry out in obedience
The selection of twelve men, one from each tribe, to take the stones
Parallel to twelve stones representing the twelve tribes of Israel at the Sinai covenant
Twelve stones with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel on the high priest's breastplate
The stones were set up in Gilgal as a memorial, showing where they were placed
The twelve tribes of Israel organized according to their fathers' houses
Elijah built an altar of twelve stones corresponding to the number of the tribes of Jacob's sons
